subject: english
title: Unit 6 Writing
subtitle: Contrast writing — land turtles and sea turtles, and the three expressions that show a difference.

content: Identify the differences between land turtles and sea turtles in the model paragraph.
Find the contrast expression in each of the five model sentences (Writing Activity 1).
Plan a contrast paragraph about two sea creatures before writing it.
language: Use but, however and In contrast, each in its own position.
Punctuate each one correctly: a comma before but, one on each side of however, one after In contrast.
Write a contrast paragraph of four sentences or more using all three expressions.

notes: The five model sentences are verbatim from the Student Book answer key for Unit 6 Writing Activity 1. The two habitat sentences come from the example fields in unit-6/vocabulary.json, which is where the swamps and woods entries were scanned from.
